name: navelia-yacht-charters
description: Search 1,300 crewed charter yachts worldwide with weekly prices, itineraries, charter VAT and booking guides from Navélia Charters.

interface.shortDescription: Find and price a yacht charter
interface.longDescription: Navélia Yacht Charters lets you plan a crewed yacht charter in a conversation. Search more than 1,300 crewed motor and sailing yachts worldwide by region, length, guests, cabins and weekly budget, and open any yacht for its specifications, weekly rate in euro and page link. Browse Navélia's own fleet for day charters in Saint-Tropez, Cannes and Monaco. Get typical weekly prices by yacht size, charter VAT by country, sample itineraries for the French Riviera, Corsica, Greece, Croatia and more, and plain explanations of APA, the MYBA charter agreement and how to choose a yacht size. Everything is read only and needs no account: the app never books, charges or sends anything. Prices are indicative and exclude expenses, VAT and gratuity. Availability and a final quote are confirmed by the Navélia team in Saint-Tropez.
defaultPrompt: Find a 40 metre motor yacht in Greece for 10 guests under 150,000 euro a week.
What does a week on a 30 metre yacht cost in the Mediterranean, VAT included?
Plan a 7 day yacht route from Saint-Tropez to Corsica.

positive.description: Search the worldwide fleet by region, guests, type and weekly budget.
positive.prompt: Find a motor yacht in Greece for 10 guests under 150,000 euro a week.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_charter_yachts with region East Mediterranean, at least 10 guests, motor yachts and a weekly budget cap of 150000. Returns a short list of yachts, each with length, guests, cabins, crew, weekly rate in euro and a link to its page on naveliacharters.com, plus a note that rates exclude expenses, VAT and gratuity.

positive.description: Open one yacht from a previous search for its full details.
positive.prompt: Find a motor yacht in Greece for 10 guests under 150,000 euro a week, then give me the full details of the first one.
positive.expected_behavior: After the search, calls get_charter_yacht with the id of the first result. Returns that yacht's builder, year, length, guests, cabins, crew, weekly rate in euro, cruising areas and its page URL on naveliacharters.com.

positive.description: Budget a charter week including VAT.
positive.prompt: What does a week on a 30 metre crewed yacht typically cost, and what VAT applies if I start in France?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a typical weekly charter rate for a crewed yacht of about 30 metres taken from Navelia's fleet data (the 30 to 40 metre band has a median near 69,000 euro, and ChatGPT may also show example yachts between about 40,000 and 80,000 euro), states that French charter VAT is 20 percent, and explains that the advance provisioning allowance and crew gratuity come on top. ChatGPT may answer the price part with get_weekly_price_guide or with a fleet search.

positive.description: Plan a route from the published itineraries.
positive.prompt: Show me a 7 day yacht itinerary for Corsica.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_itineraries with the keyword Corsica, then get_itinerary for one of the two Corsica itineraries. Returns a day by day route with ports and highlights, the best season and the itinerary page URL on naveliacharters.com.

positive.description: Find a day charter yacht from Navelia's own French Riviera fleet.
positive.prompt: Which yachts can I charter for a day from Saint-Tropez for 8 people?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_french_riviera_yachts with location Saint-Tropez and at least 8 guests. Returns day charter yachts with length, guest capacity, price per day in euro, departure ports and page links.

negative.description: Booking and payment are out of scope. The app is read only and cannot book, hold or charge. It should say so and may give Navelia's contact details so the user can enquire.
negative.prompt: Book the first yacht for 12 July and charge my card.

negative.description: Not a yacht charter request. The app has no flight, hotel or general travel search and should not be used; ChatGPT should answer without it or say the app does not cover this.
negative.prompt: Find me a flight from Amsterdam to Nice next Friday.

negative.description: The app has no live availability calendar. It must not confirm or invent availability; it should explain that availability is confirmed by the Navelia team and offer the contact details.
negative.prompt: Is the yacht Blue Diamond definitely free the first week of August? Confirm it for me.

publication.release_notes: First release. Read only search of the worldwide crewed charter fleet and Navélia's French Riviera fleet, a weekly price guide, charter VAT by country, destinations, itineraries, charter guides and contact details.
